# 📡 Simulating the Cosmic Data Universe

Since the universe hasn't provided a raw CSV file just yet, we shall *manifest* one using R! We will simulate a dataset reflecting the article's key statistics:
- 80% informal employment, 20% formal.
- Median informal earnings ~US$130/month.
- Over 156,000 POS terminals and 11.25 million mobile-money subscribers.

```{r simulate_data}
# Manifesting the Cosmic Zimbabwean Workforce Dataset
n_workers <- 1000

cosmic_workforce <- tibble(
  worker_id = 1:n_workers,
  sector = sample(c("Informal", "Formal"), size = n_workers, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.80, 0.20)),
  # Informal median ~130, Formal median ~500 (with some cosmic variance)
  monthly_income_usd = ifelse(
    sector == "Informal", 
    round(rlnorm(n_workers, meanlog = log(130), sdlog = 0.4)),
    round(rlnorm(n_workers, meanlog = log(500), sdlog = 0.5))
  ),
  happiness_index = runif(n_workers, min = 7, max = 10), # Zimbabweans are resilient and happy!
  uses_mobile_money = sample(c("Yes", "No"), size = n_workers, replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.65, 0.35)),
  pos_transactions_monthly = ifelse(sector == "Informal", 
                                    round(rpois(n_workers, lambda = 15)), 
                                    round(rpois(n_workers, lambda = 5)))
)

# Quick cosmic peek at the data
kable(head(cosmic_workforce), caption = "Table 1: A Glimpse into the Cosmic Ledger 🌌")
```

# 📊 R Analytics: Visualizing Peace, Love, and Economics

Let us chart the cosmos! We will use `ggplot2` to bring harmony and colorful insights to the data.

## 1. The 80/20 Cosmic Employment Split
A pie chart of destiny, showing the beautiful, albeit challenging, reality of Zimbabwe's labor market.

```{r plot_employment, fig.align='center'}
employment_counts <- cosmic_workforce %>%
  count(sector) %>%
  mutate(percentage = n / sum(n) * 100)

ggplot(employment_counts, aes(x = "", y = n, fill = sector)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Formal" = "#4B0082", "Informal" = "#FFD700")) + # Indigo & Cosmic Gold
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(percentage, "%")), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
  labs(title = "🌍 Zimbabwe's Workforce: The 80% Informal Cosmic Reality",
       fill = "Sector") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16))
```

## 2. Income Distribution: The "Love & Peace" Histogram
Let's look at the income distribution. Remember, behind every data point is a human being deserving of love, peace, and a fair wage!

```{r plot_income, fig.align='center'}
ggplot(cosmic_workforce, aes(x = monthly_income_usd, fill = sector)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 50, alpha = 0.7, position = "identity") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Formal" = "#4B0082", "Informal" = "#FFD700")) +
  labs(title = "💸 Monthly Income Distribution: Formal vs. Informal",
       x = "Monthly Income (USD)",
       y = "Count of Cosmic Workers",
       caption = "Data simulated based on World Bank 2026 median estimates (Informal median ~$130).") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
```

## 3. The Comedy of Errors: Happiness vs. Income
Does money buy cosmic happiness? Let's find out with a scatter plot of joy!

```{r plot_happiness, fig.align='center'}
ggplot(cosmic_workforce, aes(x = monthly_income_usd, y = happiness_index, color = sector)) +
  geom_jitter(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Formal" = "#4B0082", "Informal" = "#FFD700")) +
  labs(title = "😊 Happiness Index vs. Monthly Income",
       subtitle = "Spoiler: Zimbabweans radiate happiness regardless of the cosmic ledger!",
       x = "Monthly Income (USD)",
       y = "Happiness Index (1-10)") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "italic", color = "darkgreen", size = 12))
```

# 🧮 Cosmic Accounting Insights

As an aspiring **VBA & R Master**, I must apply the sacred principles of *Cosmic Accounting* to these findings:

1. **The Asset of Resilience**: With 11.25 million active mobile-money subscribers and over 156,000 POS terminals, Zimbabwe's informal sector is not a "liability"—it is a highly liquid, distributed *asset* of micro-entrepreneurship [[10]].
2. **Revenue Recognition**: Informal earnings are received daily or weekly. Traditional monthly accrual accounting is out; *cosmic real-time cash accounting* is in! 
3. **The VBA Connection**: Imagine a VBA macro that automatically reconciles these 236.7 million monthly mobile-money transactions into a peaceful, harmonized Excel ledger, complete with a pop-up message saying, *"Peace and Love, your books are balanced!"* *That* is the dream! 🤖💼
